model_annotation: The image presents three side-by-side pie charts detailing the proportional breakdown of subcategories within three broader textual or linguistic domains, titled "Categorical," "Approximate Number Generation," and "Disjunctive &Conjunctive." The third chart, "Disjunctive &Conjunctive," is divided into two nearly equal halves, representing "Conjunctive" in a pale mauve hue (50.49%) right of the center and "Disjunctive" in pale lavender (49.51%) on the left. None of the charts utilize an external legend; instead, all category labels and exact percentages are positioned directly inside their corresponding slices. Additionally, all charts are standard, flat pie charts with no individual segments exploded, bolded, or visually offset from the main circular shapes.
